exact.✔ 正確！稜角幾何讓切點卡軸上→係數歸零，自動選特徵。: ✔ Correct! The corner geometry makes the tangent point get stuck on an axis → the coefficient goes to zero, so features are selected automatically.
exact.✔ 正確！譜即 Σ 的特徵值/向量，選最大變異方向為主成分。: ✔ Correct! The spectrum is the eigenvalues/eigenvectors of Σ; the direction of maximum variance is chosen as the principal component.
exact.✔ 正確！嵌入後 5 分藍 vs 16 分暖，色盲用分數即可辨色。: ✔ Correct! After embedding, blue scores 5 vs. warm scores 16, so the color-blind computer can tell the colors apart just from the scores.
exact.✔ 正確！b 整體平移分數，w 決定方向；s(1,1)=2→12。: ✔ Correct! b shifts all the scores as a whole, while w sets the direction; s(1,1)=2→12.
exact.✗ 再想想：關鍵是幾何形狀（圓 vs 菱），不是罰金大小。: ✗ Think again: the key is the geometric shape (circle vs. diamond), not the size of the penalty.
exact.✗ 提示：譜 = 特徵值，哪個方向最亂就保留哪個。: ✗ Hint: spectrum = eigenvalues; keep whichever direction is the most spread out.
exact.✗ 提示：監督後紅藍被拉開揉緊，分數已可分。: ✗ Hint: after supervision, red and blue have been pulled apart and squeezed tight, so the scores already separate them.
exact.✗ 提示：平移整片點雲的是哪個參數？: ✗ Hint: which parameter shifts the whole point cloud?

a95d7687efbf.zh:
統計回歸 × 統計降維
從罰金到壓扁的幾何藝術
a95d7687efbf.en:
Statistical Regression × Statistical Dimensionality Reduction
The Geometric Art of Going from Penalties to Squeezing

ff6f34b17d5f.zh: 教電腦當算命先生，用幾何把行李箱壓成紙片 Teach machines to predict, and squeeze suitcases into paper — penalty & geometry.
ff6f34b17d5f.en: Teach the computer to be a fortune-teller, and use geometry to squash a suitcase flat as a sheet of paper

a8dd39a1fe15.zh: 📐 最小平方 · Least Squares 💰 罰金幾何 · Penalty Geometry 📦 主成分 · PCA 🎨 側資訊 · Side Info
a8dd39a1fe15.en: 📐 Least Squares 💰 Penalty Geometry 📦 Principal Components (PCA) 🎨 Side Information

afc490816a6e.zh: ▾ SCROLL TO EXPLORE · 長頁自學模式
afc490816a6e.en: ▾ SCROLL TO EXPLORE · Long-Page Self-Study Mode

6a506bd2cb96.zh:
為何電腦會「學歪」？
又為何高維數據要「壓扁」才看得懂？Why do models overfit? Why must high-D data be squeezed to be understood?
6a506bd2cb96.en:
Why do computers “learn crooked”?
And why does high-dimensional data have to be “squashed flat” before we can make sense of it?

21db59d4c86f.zh: 一個要「罰」——用幾何逼係數變乖；一個要「壓」——用幾何把混亂的行李箱摺成紙片。One needs a penalty to tame coefficients; the other needs squeezing to reveal structure.
21db59d4c86f.en: One needs a “penalty”: geometry forces the coefficients to behave. The other needs “squashing”: geometry folds a messy suitcase into a sheet of paper.

346c1e2b344c.zh: 兩大支柱：預測與壓縮 Two Pillars — Prediction & Compression
346c1e2b344c.en: The Two Pillars: Prediction and Compression

b2372db4b2f0.zh: 回歸管「從 $X$ 猜 $y$」，降維管「把 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 變 $\mathbb{R}^p$（$p \lt d$）還保留靈魂」。一個對準標籤，一個對準結構。Regression: $X\to y$ prediction. Reduction: $\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^p$ with soul preserved.
b2372db4b2f0.en: Regression is in charge of “guessing $y$ from $X$”; dimensionality reduction is in charge of “turning $\mathbb{R}^d$ into $\mathbb{R}^p$ ($p \lt d$) while keeping its soul.” One aims at the labels, the other at the structure.

bdceaa290016.zh: 找 $f_\theta(X)\approx y$，用誤差 $\|y-\hat y\|^2$ 當罪過值；怕學歪就加罰金 $\lambda\|\theta\|$。Find $f_\theta\approx y$; penalize wild $\theta$.
bdceaa290016.en: Find $f_\theta(X)\approx y$, using the error $\|y-\hat y\|^2$ as the “sin score”; if you're afraid it will learn crooked, add a penalty $\lambda\|\theta\|$.

1d9f54436165.zh: 特徵 $X$ → 標籤 $y$，線性只是起點。Features → label; linear is just the start.
1d9f54436165.en: Features $X$ → label $y$; linear is just the starting point.

a2e1e23e555b.zh: 把行李箱壓成紙片：譜方法看幾何（特徵值）、機率方法看潛在因子。Squeeze suitcase to paper: spectral = geometry, probabilistic = latent factors.
a2e1e23e555b.en: Squash the suitcase into a sheet of paper: spectral methods look at geometry (eigenvalues), probabilistic methods look at latent factors.

520137574798.zh: 監督時更狠：同類揉緊、異類拉開。Supervised: tighten within, pull apart between.
520137574798.en: With supervision it gets even more ruthless: squeeze same-class points tight, pull different classes apart.

f24e0f286ac6.zh: 共同語言：幾何 Geometry unifies

cdccca78baf4.zh: Lasso 的稜角讓係數歸零、PCA 的方向讓變異最大、監督降維把空間拉扯重塑——全是幾何在說話。Lasso corners → sparsity; PCA direction → max variance; supervised pull/push → new space.
cdccca78baf4.en: Lasso's corners send coefficients to zero, PCA's direction maximizes variance, and supervised dimensionality reduction stretches and reshapes the space: it's geometry doing the talking every time.

e4c4be1b6dcc.zh: 能簡單就別複雜：Lasso 把不重要特徵係數壓到 0，降維把 $d$ 維減到 $p$ 維——都在刪。Simpler wins: zero out weak features, shrink dimensions.
e4c4be1b6dcc.en: If it can be simple, don't make it complicated: Lasso squeezes the coefficients of unimportant features to 0, and dimensionality reduction cuts $d$ dimensions down to $p$. Both are deleting things.

eb7c01606dcd.zh: 直覺 · 一句話記住 One-Liner
eb7c01606dcd.en: Intuition · Remember It in One Sentence

fbe99e5e5998.zh: 回歸是「算命」——給線索猜分數；降維是「收納」——把亂衣櫃摺到看得懂的抽屜。Regression = fortune-telling from clues; reduction = folding a messy closet.
fbe99e5e5998.en: Regression is “fortune-telling”: given clues, guess the score. Dimensionality reduction is “tidying up”: fold a messy closet into drawers you can make sense of.

07bdfe58cb6b.zh: 一、統計回歸：教電腦當算命先生 Regression — Fortune-Telling Machine
07bdfe58cb6b.en: 1. Statistical Regression: Teaching the Computer to Be a Fortune-Teller

90e1b462edeb.zh: 特徵 $X$（讀書時數、缺課次數）→ 標籤 $y$（期末分數），回歸找 $f_\theta$ 使 $\hat y = f_\theta(X)$ 最接近 $y$。Features $X$ → label $y$; find $f_\theta$ with $\hat y\approx y$.
90e1b462edeb.en: Features $X$ (hours studied, number of absences) → label $y$ (final exam score); regression finds $f_\theta$ such that $\hat y = f_\theta(X)$ is as close as possible to $y$.

2e27284d8311.zh: 線性回歸：多讀 1h +5 分，缺課 1 次 −10 分
2e27284d8311.en: Linear regression: +1h study = +5 pts, 1 absence = −10 pts

7e480868a990.zh: ŷ = θ1·讀書 + θ2·缺課 + b

c64f5e207bfd.zh: 罪過值 MSE = (1/n) Σ (y − ŷ)² → 最小化
c64f5e207bfd.en: Sin score MSE = (1/n) Σ (y − ŷ)² → minimize

ac946f6a23ec.zh: 特徵→模型→預測，誤差平方為罪，目標最小化 · Features → model → prediction; squared error is the sin.
ac946f6a23ec.en: Features → model → prediction; the squared error is the sin, and the goal is to minimize it.

b00edf7420ce.zh: 「多讀 1 小時 +5 分」是線性直覺：$\hat y = \theta_1 x_1 + \theta_2 x_2 + b$。簡單、可解釋、凸優化。Linear: $\hat y=\theta_1x_1+\theta_2x_2+b$ — simple & convex.
b00edf7420ce.en: “Study 1 more hour, get +5 points” is linear intuition: $\hat y = \theta_1 x_1 + \theta_2 x_2 + b$. Simple, interpretable, and a convex optimization problem.

6746b1323642.zh: 預測差太多就重罰，且平方後不論正負都算罪。電腦的唯一 KPI：讓總罪過最小。Big gap = big squared sin; minimize total.
6746b1323642.en: If a prediction is way off, it gets heavily penalized, and after squaring, an error counts as a sin whether it is positive or negative. The computer's one and only KPI: make the total sin as small as possible.

40512880de62.zh: 何時失靈 When It Fails

15536b72f4c9.zh: 為貼合考古題（訓練集）學出離譜係數 $-50000$——過擬合警報，需罰金。Fitting training quirks with huge $\theta$ → overfit, needs penalty.
15536b72f4c9.en: To fit the past exam questions (the training set), it learns an absurd coefficient like $-50000$: an overfitting alarm, and a penalty is needed.

a2c68e1723aa.zh: 公式 · 線性回歸與最小平方
a2c68e1723aa.en: Formula · Linear Regression and Least Squares

28acaddfb16a.zh: 最小化 $\mathcal{L}_{\text{MSE}}$ 即讓預測貼近真相；但無正則時 $\theta$ 可能失控。Minimize MSE to fit; without penalty $\theta$ may explode.
28acaddfb16a.en: Minimizing $\mathcal{L}_{\text{MSE}}$ means making the predictions stick close to the truth; but without regularization, $\theta$ can spiral out of control.

fc37a3da460b.zh: 怕高的係數：Ridge 與 Lasso Taming Wild Coefficients
fc37a3da460b.en: Coefficients Afraid of Heights: Ridge and Lasso

0ee41e5616d3.zh: 罰金加在罪過值後：$\mathcal{L} = \text{MSE} + \alpha\|\theta\|$。Ridge 用 $\ell_2$ 讓係數溫和，Lasso 用 $\ell_1$ 讓係數歸零。Add penalty $\alpha\|\theta\|$: Ridge ($\ell_2$) smooths, Lasso ($\ell_1$) zeros out.
0ee41e5616d3.en: Add the penalty on top of the sin score: $\mathcal{L} = \text{MSE} + \alpha\|\theta\|$. Ridge uses $\ell_2$ to keep coefficients mild; Lasso uses $\ell_1$ to drive coefficients to zero.

c4f3cba986a0.zh: Tikhonov 1943/1962，圓形單位球。Circular ball, smooth.

a1d4d1eb3cd4.zh: 罰金 $\alpha\|\theta\|_2^2=\alpha\sum\theta_j^2$：$\theta=10000$ → 罰 $10^8$，逼溫和 (huge $\theta$ = huge fine)
a1d4d1eb3cd4.en: Penalty $\alpha\|\theta\|_2^2=\alpha\sum\theta_j^2$: $\theta=10000$ → a fine of $10^8$, which forces it to stay mild

1267865cad98.zh: 幾何圓滑 → 係數縮小但不為 0 (shrink, not zero)
1267865cad98.en: Smooth geometry → coefficients shrink but don't become 0

01106780e0c0.zh: 適合共線特徵、穩定解 (stable with collinearity)
01106780e0c0.en: Good for collinear features; gives a stable solution

2705878bb302.zh: 球面光滑 → 切點不在軸上。Smooth ball → rarely on axis.
2705878bb302.en: The ball's surface is smooth → the tangent point does not land on an axis.

5766bb913250.zh: Tibshirani 1996，菱形單位球，有稜角。Diamond, pointy.
5766bb913250.en: Tibshirani 1996, a diamond-shaped unit ball with sharp corners.

75c78f79d385.zh: 罰金 $\alpha\|\theta\|_1=\alpha\sum|\theta_j|$：絕對值在 0 點不平滑 ($|\theta|$ kinky at 0)
75c78f79d385.en: Penalty $\alpha\|\theta\|_1=\alpha\sum|\theta_j|$: the absolute value is not smooth at 0

97516a7a220d.zh: 幾何有稜角 → 切點卡在軸上→$\theta_j=0$ (corner → zero)
97516a7a220d.en: Cornered geometry → the tangent point gets stuck on an axis → $\theta_j=0$

b47713473088.zh: 自動特徵選擇，稀疏解 (auto-select, sparse)

98fdc13be50a.zh: 稜角 → 壓到軸上→稀疏。Pointy → hits axis → sparse.
98fdc13be50a.en: Corners → pressed onto an axis → sparse.

fcc70200bbf5.zh: Ridge · 圓滑球：切點不在軸上
fcc70200bbf5.en: Ridge · smooth ball: tangent point off the axes

5ca3472aab77.zh: Lasso · 菱形尖角：切點卡軸上 → 稀疏
5ca3472aab77.en: Lasso · diamond corners: tangent point on an axis → sparse

f0f8cf600d88.zh: 左圓右菱：等高線（藍虛線）與罰金球相切；稜角讓 Lasso 卡軸上 → 係數歸零 · Smooth vs pointy: tangency decides sparsity.
f0f8cf600d88.en: Circle on the left, diamond on the right: the contour lines (blue dashed) touch the penalty ball; the corners make Lasso stick to an axis → coefficients go to zero.

771378eafffd.zh: Lasso 數值：為何逼到 0 Why Lasso Zeros Out — Numbers
771378eafffd.en: Lasso by the Numbers: Why It Pushes to 0

e676e3d8cdce.zh: 單一特徵 $\theta_2$（缺課），罰金 $\alpha|\theta_2|$，$\alpha=100$。大係數罰重，小係數便宜，0 免費。One feature $\theta_2$, penalty $100|\theta_2|$: big = expensive, zero = free.
e676e3d8cdce.en: A single feature $\theta_2$ (number of absences), penalty $\alpha|\theta_2|$, $\alpha=100$. Big coefficients are fined heavily, small ones are cheap, and 0 is free.

6d36b71e321a.zh: 罰金隨係數變化（可調 $\alpha$） · Penalty vs Coefficient

fea21d954b48.zh:
$\alpha=100$ 時：
$\theta_2=-10$ → $100\cdot10=1000$（付不起）
$\theta_2=-0.1$ → $100\cdot0.1=10$（便宜）
$\theta_2=0$ → $0$（免費，刪特徵）Big → bankruptcy; zero → free & sparse.
fea21d954b48.en:
When $\alpha=100$:
$\theta_2=-10$ → $100\cdot10=1000$ (can't afford it)
$\theta_2=-0.1$ → $100\cdot0.1=10$ (cheap)
$\theta_2=0$ → $0$ (free; the feature is deleted)

f4900fe8c56f.zh: 為何 0 特別誘人 Why Zero Wins

c6ea8f7bfd25.zh: $\ell_1$ 在 0 點不平滑、有稜角，對小係數懲罰敏感，優化路徑易卡尖角 → 自動刪「穿藍襪子」這類無用特徵。Kink at 0 is sticky → optimizer gets trapped → auto-deletes noise features.
c6ea8f7bfd25.en: $\ell_1$ is not smooth at 0 and has a sharp corner there; it penalizes small coefficients sensitively, so the optimization path easily gets stuck at the corner → it automatically deletes useless features like “wears blue socks.”

86503e4cd332.zh: 稀疏的幾何魔術：圖上看懂 Sparsity Geometry — See It
86503e4cd332.en: The Geometric Magic of Sparsity: See It on the Plot

3ae3e7f9a760.zh: 左：誤差等高線（藍）與 $\ell_1$ 菱（橙）相切於尖角 → $\theta_1=0$。右：輸入→輸出映射 $s(\mathbf{x})=w^\top\mathbf{x}+b$ 的分數色階與平移。Left tangency at corner → zero; right linear mapping & bias shift.
3ae3e7f9a760.en: Left: the error contours (blue) touch the $\ell_1$ diamond (orange) at a corner → $\theta_1=0$. Right: the score color scale and shift of the input→output mapping $s(\mathbf{x})=w^\top\mathbf{x}+b$.

dd66e52cdf2c.zh: 左：Lasso 單位球與稀疏切點 · 稜角卡軸 Diamond tangency
dd66e52cdf2c.en: Left: Lasso Unit Ball and Sparse Tangent Point · Corners Stick to the Axes

cdfbd5e78e02.zh: 橙菱 $\ell_1\le0.5$ 四角在軸上；藍虛線為 MSE 等高線，交於 $(0,0.5)$ → $\theta_1=0$ 稀疏解 Orange diamond corners on axes; intersection at $(0,0.5)$.
cdfbd5e78e02.en: The orange diamond $\ell_1\le0.5$ has its four corners on the axes; the blue dashed lines are MSE contours, which meet it at $(0,0.5)$ → the sparse solution $\theta_1=0$

462c1e186619.zh: 右：線性映射 $s(\mathbf{x})=x_1+x_2+b$ 的色階與偏置平移 Scores & bias shift
462c1e186619.en: Right: Color Scale and Bias Shift of the Linear Mapping $s(\mathbf{x})=x_1+x_2+b$

46b96eb0bda6.en: Color scale $x_1+x_2+b$ (low scores blue → high scores warm)

c899e8b4eb36.zh: 點 $\mathbf{x}=(1,1)$：$b=0$ 時 $s=2$（低分藍）；$b=10$ 時 $s=12$（整片平移 10） $\mathbf{x}=(1,1)$: $2$ at $b=0$, $12$ at $b=10$.
c899e8b4eb36.en: Point $\mathbf{x}=(1,1)$: at $b=0$, $s=2$ (low score, blue); at $b=10$, $s=12$ (the whole map shifts by 10)

583e33dcb790.zh: 罰金幾何決定稀疏：圓滑→縮小，稜角→歸零；映射幾何決定分數：$w$ 定方向，$b$ 定平移。Geometry decides: smooth → shrink, pointy → zero; $w$ sets direction, $b$ sets shift.
583e33dcb790.en: Penalty geometry decides sparsity: smooth → shrink, corners → zero. Mapping geometry decides the scores: $w$ sets the direction, $b$ sets the shift.

731ef673a27d.zh: 譜降維 PCA：把行李箱壓扁 PCA — Squeeze the Suitcase
731ef673a27d.en: Spectral Dimensionality Reduction with PCA: Squashing the Suitcase

4d4a32624b1f.zh: 數據活在 $\mathbb{R}^d$，PCA 找「變異最大」的線性方向投影到 $\mathbb{R}^2$（或 $\mathbb{R}^p$），特徵值即譜。Live in $\mathbb{R}^d$, project to $p$ dims along max variance — eigenvalues = spectrum.
4d4a32624b1f.en: The data live in $\mathbb{R}^d$; PCA finds the linear directions of “largest variance” and projects onto $\mathbb{R}^2$ (or $\mathbb{R}^p$); the eigenvalues are the spectrum.

ab7f2cafbaa2.zh: matplotlib 精準繪製：點雲協方差譜 $\lambda_1=6.01$ vs $\lambda_2=0.47$；PC1（橙實線）為最大變異方向，虛線為投影；色階為 PC1 分數 · Precise: covariance spectrum & orthogonal projection.
ab7f2cafbaa2.en: Drawn precisely with matplotlib: the covariance spectrum of the point cloud, $\lambda_1=6.01$ vs $\lambda_2=0.47$; PC1 (solid orange line) is the direction of largest variance, the dashed lines are the projections, and the color scale is the PC1 score.

6367d955b9c8.zh: 為何是特徵值 Why Eigen

f04f830a6d72.zh: 協方差 $\Sigma$ 的特徵向量即主方向，特徵值即該方向變異量；譜分析故名「譜降維」。Eigenvectors = directions; eigenvalues = variance.
f04f830a6d72.en: The eigenvectors of the covariance $\Sigma$ are the principal directions, and the eigenvalues are the variance along those directions; it is spectral analysis, hence the name “spectral dimensionality reduction.”

661e6745071d.zh: 高維行李箱硬塞進紙箱：PCA 讓你選「最鼓的方向」壓，丟掉最扁的方向。Stuff suitcase into paper: keep bulging, drop flat.
661e6745071d.en: Cramming a high-dimensional suitcase into a cardboard box: PCA lets you pick the “bulgiest direction” to squash along and throw away the flattest direction.

2cade5603b75.zh: PCA 僅線性投影；流形彎曲時需核 PCA / t-SNE / UMAP。Linear only; curved manifolds need nonlinear.
2cade5603b75.en: PCA is only a linear projection; when the manifold is curved, you need kernel PCA / t-SNE / UMAP.

3e566a709c1a.zh: 最大變異方向即 $\Sigma$ 最大特徵值對應特徵向量；譜即 $\{\lambda_i\}$。Max variance direction = top eigenvector of $\Sigma$.
3e566a709c1a.en: The direction of maximum variance is the eigenvector belonging to the largest eigenvalue of $\Sigma$; the spectrum is $\{\lambda_i\}$.

2726d95b3eba.zh: 機率式與監督式降維：色盲辨色 Probabilistic & Supervised — Color-Blind Task
2726d95b3eba.en: Probabilistic and Supervised Dimensionality Reduction: Telling Colors Apart While Color-Blind

d20ca01cf083.zh: 機率式假設 $x$ 由潛在因子 + 雜訊生成；監督式再加側資訊 $y$（紅/藍標籤），重塑空間：拉開類間、揉緊類內。Latent factors + noise; supervised adds $y$ to reshape: pull between, tighten within.
d20ca01cf083.en: Probabilistic methods assume $x$ is generated by latent factors + noise; supervised methods also add side information $y$ (red/blue labels) to reshape the space: pull the classes apart, squeeze each class tight.

e944a447e6b7.zh: 灰度 [5,10] 混散，10 顆球看不出差別。Grey blur, no separation.
e944a447e6b7.en: Grayscale values [5,10] all mixed together; you can't tell the 10 balls apart.

bb619d8c920d.zh: 假設 $\mathbf{x}=W\mathbf{z}+\epsilon$，$\mathbf{z}$ 為潛因子 (latent)
bb619d8c920d.en: Assume $\mathbf{x}=W\mathbf{z}+\epsilon$, where $\mathbf{z}$ is the latent factor

c3b9a1e0aff5.zh: 因子分析 / pPCA 找結構，不知顏色 (find structure blind)
c3b9a1e0aff5.en: Factor analysis / pPCA find structure without knowing the colors

f9cdc3e2d3d9.zh: 色盲視角：全是灰球 (all grey)
f9cdc3e2d3d9.en: The color-blind view: all the balls are grey

e4d78371e689.zh: 已知紅/藍，幾何改造 $\mathbf{x}\to\mathbf{y}$（$d=2\to p=1$）。With labels, reshape $\mathbf{x}\to\mathbf{y}$.
e4d78371e689.en: With red/blue known, reshape the geometry $\mathbf{x}\to\mathbf{y}$ ($d=2\to p=1$).

c5812f9b481a.zh: 推開類間：紅雲 vs 藍雲遠離 (push apart)
c5812f9b481a.en: Push the classes apart: the red cloud and the blue cloud move away from each other

32da53e41407.zh: 收攏類內：各自揉成緊團 (3,3) vs (16,16) (tighten within)
32da53e41407.en: Pull each class together: each one squeezes into a tight cluster, (3,3) vs (16,16)

ae30c43db73b.zh: 結果：分數 5 分藍、16 分暖，色盲也能分 (scores 5 vs 16)
ae30c43db73b.en: Result: a score of 5 is blue and 16 is warm, so even the color-blind can tell them apart

3377731fbaca.zh: 緊團 + 遠離 = 可分

8a6db4e97eb9.zh: 無監督混散 → 監督拉扯：類間遠、類內緊、p=1 分數即可辨色 · Blur → supervised pull/push → separable scores.

94583b48e226.zh:
特徵多且可刪 → Lasso 稀疏；
共線重、求穩 → Ridge 縮小；
無標籤想看結構 → PCA；
有標籤想分開 → 監督拉扯；
彎曲流形 → 非線性降維。Many deletable → Lasso; collinear → Ridge; no labels → PCA; labels → supervised pull/push.
94583b48e226.en:
Many features that can be dropped → Lasso, sparse;
heavy collinearity, want stability → Ridge, shrink;
no labels, want to see structure → PCA;
labels, want to separate classes → supervised pull/push;
curved manifold → nonlinear dimensionality reduction.

b239786ae8e7.zh: Ridge 圓→縮、Lasso 尖→零、PCA 壓最亂、監督拉開揉緊——全是幾何在說話。Ridge shrink, Lasso zero, PCA max variance, supervised pull/push — all geometry.
b239786ae8e7.en: Ridge round → shrink, Lasso pointy → zero, PCA squeezes along the most spread-out direction, supervised pulls apart and pulls together: it is all geometry talking.
